pieces.source_pages: Printed 70 / PDF 79; vocal bars 5-20, first ending only
pieces.genre_evidence: Joseph David S. Legaspi, Filipino Diction for Singers (Indiana University, 2014), printed 66 calls this a Kundiman; notation on printed 70.

pieces.genre_evidence: Isidora Kabigting Miranda, Dissonant Voices (University of Wisconsin-Madison, 2020), printed 57-58 identifies and compares these historical Kundiman vocal melodies.

pieces.title: Bituing Marikit
pieces.source_pages: Printed 87-88 / PDF 96-97; vocal bars 9-24, first ending only
pieces.genre_evidence: Legaspi (2014), printed 66 explicitly includes Bituing Marikit in the Kundiman repertoire. This edition is in C minor, 2/4; triplets are exact.
pieces.rights_notes: Underlying 1926 Abelardo melody only. The 2014 thesis is copyrighted, not CC licensed; no lyrics, IPA, translation, accompaniment or PDF pages redistributed.
pieces.label_scope: Kundiman repertoire, 2/4 example; existing corpus also includes Ikaw Rin in 2/4. Retain original meter; report separately from triple-meter examples.

pieces.title: El Cundiman (documented 1892)
pieces.source_pages: Printed 35 / PDF 42; first eight vocal bars
pieces.genre_evidence: The historical notation explicitly titles the melody El Cundiman. Publication date is 1892; no composition date or named composer is asserted.
pieces.rights_notes: Anonymous historical melody from an 1892 publication, transcribed from the UST library scan; no lyrics, accompaniment, watermark, PDF page or modern arrangement redistributed.
pieces.label_scope: Historical folk Kundiman, C major, 3/4; retain chromatic approach notes, the opening eighth rest, three quarter rests and the bar-six fermata.
pieces.alias_audit: No matching 16-sounding-note pitch-interval/relative-duration phrase against the prior 23 Kundiman excerpts. Full composition-level alias reconciliation remains incomplete.
